search_presets.description: Balanced Nagao j=1728 scan with exact t ~ -t deduplication.

provenance.author: Koh-ichi Nagao
provenance.paper: On the rank of elliptic curve y^2 = x^3 - kx
provenance.published_claim: Infinitely many pairwise non-Q-isomorphic curves y^2=x^3-kx with rank >=4.
provenance.control: t=3 gives (a,b,c,d)=(133,-134,158,-59) and four independent points.
provenance.factorization_denominator: The OCR flattens the denominator in equation (2.1); direct substitution from a(T),b(T) and the t=3 control confirms the denominator is 2^24.
provenance.symmetry: k(t) is even, hence t and -t give the same curve; Rank Hunter declares exact sign symmetry for candidate deduplication.
provenance.current_subfamily_frontier: A 2026 prescribed-rank survey cites Watkins's j=1728 curve of rank 14 as the known high-rank example over Q; record-oriented search therefore targets 15.
provenance.exact_rank_boundary: Nagao proves a lower bound, not exact generic rank 4. Rank Hunter records only verified lower bound 4.

pipeline_search.strategy_note: Nagao four-section baseline plus plugin-local ratpoints; core owns exact certification and rank promotion.
